title: Generating highly concentrated yeast whole cell extract using low-cost equipment.
protocol: Thaw cell pellet in a mixture of ice and water if frozen.
Dissolve the pellet in 200 μl of ice cold breaking buffer with inhibitors.
Add 700 μl volume of acid washed glass beads to the sample.
Vortex the sample at maximum speed for 30 seconds.
Place the sample in a mixture of ice and water for 30 seconds.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 seven more times.
Spin samples at 4°C for 3 minutes at low g (e.g., 2,500g).
Transfer supernatant to fresh microfuge tubes if round base tubes are used.
Spin the supernatants in a microfuge centrifuge at 4°C for 10 minutes at 10,000 rpm.
Determine the protein concentration via the Bradford method.
Or determine the A<sub>260nm</sub> using breaking buffer alone as reference.
